title: Neidin, Rahilla, Kildare, Co. Kildare, R51DY22
seoTitle: Neidin, Rahilla, Kildare, Co. Kildare, R51DY22
description:
Tony Donnelly of LWK is delighted to present this stunning family home.

This magnificent A rated four bedroom c.194.04 sq mts Country residence set back from the road on c.2.4 acres of stud railed paddocks, accessed through a recessed entrance with electronic gates and gravel drive with bollard lighting.

Downstairs has very extensive living accommodation with underfloor heating, comprising of open plan kitchen/dining area with French double doors leading a south west facing patio area.

Very spacious separate sitting/living room with sliding double doors leading to back garden, double bedroom, home office, utility room and guest w/c complete downstairs.
Upstairs has a beautiful bright and spacious landing with raised ceiling three double bedroom’s, master with en-suite, walk in wardrobe and balcony overlooking beautiful countryside. The stunning family bathroom and plant room completes upstairs.

This property is finished to an exceptional high standard and needs to be seen to be believed, it will make an ideal family home for any purchaser.
Located just off the R401 Kildare to Rathangan road and within easy access to Kildare town centre, primary/secondary schools and all local amenities and short drive to the to the world famous Curragh plains/ racecourse & the  M7 motorway at Kildare village junction 13.
